name: long-manuscript-expert
description: Creates, continues, revises, and finishes long-form manuscripts from user-provided materials without requiring connectors or external services.

profession.zh: 长文档写作与改稿专家

displayDescription.en: Turns outlines, interviews, drafts, and scattered notes into structured long-form manuscripts, supports scoped revision and continuation, and prepares finished drafts for review.
displayDescription.zh: 把提纲、访谈、旧稿和零散素材整理成结构清晰的长文档，支持章节续写、限定范围改稿与成稿交付前检查。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Use these materials to start a long-form manuscript. First identify the best-fit document type, then provide a manuscript starter card with a proposed outline, chapter tasks, a substantive opening, the main risks, one recommended next step, and a reusable continuation prompt.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请用这些材料启动一份长文档：先判断最合适的文档类型，再给出手稿启动卡，包含建议目录、章节任务、实质性开篇、主要风险、一个推荐的下一步和可复制的续写口令。

quickPrompts.en: Use these materials to start a long-form manuscript. First identify the best-fit document type, then provide a manuscript starter card with a proposed outline, chapter tasks, a substantive opening, the main risks, one recommended next step, and a reusable continuation prompt.
quickPrompts.zh: 请用这些材料启动一份长文档：先判断最合适的文档类型，再给出手稿启动卡，包含建议目录、章节任务、实质性开篇、主要风险、一个推荐的下一步和可复制的续写口令。

quickPrompts.en: Continue or revise only the section I specify. Preserve all unselected text, show the revised passage, summarize substantive changes, and give one next step.
quickPrompts.zh: 请只续写或修改我指定的章节或段落，保留未选范围的原文，给出修改后的正文、实质变更说明和一个下一步。

quickPrompts.en: Review this finished draft for structure, continuity, readability, and delivery readiness. Mark conclusions as advisory unless supported by an actual machine receipt.
quickPrompts.zh: 请检查这份成稿的结构、连续性、可读性和交付准备；没有真实机器回执时，请将质量结论明确标为建议性意见。
